description:
[measured] Raw X (Twitter) search: one page of up to ~20 posts for any advanced-search query,
    each with text, time, author (username, followers, verified), likes, retweets, replies, quotes
    and views, plus next_cursor for the following page. Not limited to crypto. For a coin's
    sentiment next to its positioning use get_crypto_twitter instead. Priced: $0.005 a page (x402
    or MPP), 1 prepaid credit, or a Pro/Bot key; a free key's allowance does not cover it.
